svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Clamp-on 3-phase energy & machine-health monitor — prototype blueprint v1.0

g.text: Wired as a remote STOP in the
Net label (connects to the peripheral of the same name)
Split-core CTs go around the existing cables and a
plug-in 9 VAC adapter gives the voltage reference.
No mains wiring inside the node.
Power, vibration and housing temperature on one
timeline: spots bearing wear, compressed-air leaks
and overload long before a breakdown.
The relay is only a remote STOP in the machine's
control circuit — it never starts machinery. HOLD
RTC + supercap last-gasp log every outage and
voltage sag with a timestamp — power-quality

svg.text: * Estimates to be verified on the bench. Prototype — not a certified product. CT clamps and control-circuit wiring must be installed by a licensed electrician. Remote STOP is not an emergency stop.
